overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Open Meeting Law does not reach Town Meeting, so the Board's private caucuses during a remote Special Town Meeting were not a violation.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated during the February 22 Special Town Meeting without posting notice of a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we reiterate our interpretation that the Open Meeting Law does not reach any aspect of Town Meeting and conclude that the Board’s discussions did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's private caucus discussions during the Special Town Meeting were conducted in a manner inaccessible to the public.
allegations.key_passage: However, as the Special Town Meeting was held remotely, the Board’s discussions via private teleconference were analogous to the common practice of members of select boards to sit together during Town Meetings so that they may consult and respond to matters as they arise during Town Meeting.
